text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolution] Red Lv.6 + black Lv.6: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast DNA Digivolve ([Durandamon] + [BryweLudramon])＞ (1 of your specified Digimon and 1 specified card in the hand may DNA digivolve into this card.) ＜Raid＞ ＜Reboot＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top card of your opponent's security stack, and this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's effects until the end of their turn. Then, if DNA digivolving, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon and delete 1 of their Digimon.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 5 memory.)
